notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador API, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It sends the standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction with HLAexceptionReporting true and false, verifies the public Exception Reporting getter, and confirms that neighboring public switch values remain unchanged. It does not test HLAreportException delivery or rely on provider-specific names, registries, headers, or internal switch state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM interaction and parameter lookup, receive-order sendInteraction, Exception Reporting and neighboring switch queries, and federation lifecycle
